newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SELONDA TO RAISE 96 DIV/SHARE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SELONDA TO RAISE 96 DIV/SHARE.

text.p: Greece's Selonda Aquaculture said its fiscal 1996 pretax profit rose to 1.6 billion drachmas from 809 million a year earlier.
Sales also grew 30.7 percent to 1.7 billion drachmas from 1.3 billion in 1995.
"Management intends to raise the fiscal 1996 dividend per share," the company said. It paid a dividend per share of 30 drachmas in 1995.

Selonda plans investments of around four billion drachmas by the year 2000, all self-financed. It said exports through its subsidiary Eurofish Hellas exceeded 1,500 tonnes of sea bass and sea bream in 1996.

The group which also includes Riopesca Fisheries said 75 percent of its sales went to foreign markets with Italy absorbing 82 percent while newer markets like Germany and Britain accounted for the remaining 18 percent.
Selonda donated 2.0 million drachmas to support flood victims in the city of Corinth.
Its shares closed up 20 drachmas at 1,330 on Monday.
